pull_request.title: Software: install unrooted for documentation plots
pull_request.head: codex/issue95-unrooted
pull_request.body:
Closes #95.

Adds a dedicated documentation plotting environment pinned to unrooted `0.1.0rc1` at `728465dce0c5cd5b876e67392e3858de6e982d05`, with transitive dependency pins and optional Plotly. Setup and CLI examples live in `software/analysis/README.md`; the installed local environment is under ignored `software/build/unrooted-venv`.

The repeatable smoke check verifies the installed Git revision, exact ROOT histogram values/variances/edges, bundled ODD styling, a ratio overlay, PNG/PDF/SVG export, self-contained Plotly HTML, and CLI help/PNG export. Retains the local version/hash report and adds an independent Linux/Python 3.11 CI job. Project tracking, source provenance and the session journal are updated. The project-record fixture now includes software sources while excluding builds and submodules.

Validation: smoke and 24-package compatibility checks passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.11.15; all 28 project-record tests passed; software layout, project/session records, token validation/preview and whitespace checks passed. Hosted project validation, Linux smoke and token-site checks passed at `e7b4b90701b2b0269cbbe42af0e2cd9ce5f4f59c`; checks rerun for the accounting update. Synthetic data checks the installation; no detector performance claim is made.

Token accounting for issue #95 and PR #96 (recovered 2026-10-23):

| Counter | Observed tokens |
| --- | ---: |
| Input | 7,137,997 |
| Output | 24,680 |
| **Total: input + output** | **7,162,677** |
| Cached input, included in input | 7,031,040 |
| Reasoning output, included in output | 8,526 |

The issue implementation, installation, validation and PR creation/delivery share one completed turn covering 60 observed requests, counted once. All cumulative increases reconcile from zero against last-request counters; no repeated snapshots, outside-turn events, child threads or prior usage owners were found. Import replay adds zero entries. The original journal owns the entry; the recovery inventory only corroborates it.

Evidence: [original journal](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/issue95-unrooted/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-10-23-unrooted-install.md), [usage-only inventory](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/issue95-unrooted/logs/usage/USAGE-2026-10-23-pr96-accounting.json), [accounting follow-up](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/issue95-unrooted/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-10-23-pr96-accounting.md).

The current accounting turn is still active: its snapshot is an excluded provisional lower bound, to be finalized only after its closed boundary is available. Actual model/client version, billing and other-device completeness are unknown. These are all completed recorded issue95/PR96 turn counters, not an estimate for an unfinished turn.

Accounting validation: 33 session/recovery tests and 10 token-site tests pass; project/session/usage validators, token-site preview and whitespace checks pass.

Installed upstream `728465dce0c5cd5b876e67392e3858de6e982d05` (`0.1.0rc1`),
the public main revision observed at intake, rather than the locally modified
development checkout. Inspected its README, pyproject, source interfaces,
packaging smoke example and MIT license. The installation is under ignored
`software/build/unrooted-venv`, using CPython 3.11.15 on macOS arm64. The ACTS/Spack
environment is independent and was not needed for this ROOT-independent tool.

The requirement input pins the full Git revision; the universal generated file
pins transitive dependencies, including Python-version markers. Optional Plotly
provides self-contained HTML. Matplotlib provides PNG/PDF/SVG. The repeatable
smoke check uses arbitrary, deterministic fixture counts with no random seed or
physical detector interpretation. It verifies the installed Git origin, loaded
edges/counts/variances, bundled ODD styling, ratio overlay and CLI. Generated PNG
was visually inspected and has clear labels and a complete ratio panel.

Added a dedicated hosted Linux/Python 3.11 smoke job. Local results do not qualify
other Python versions or platforms. Added TASK-SOFT-UNROOTED and SRC-UNROOTED;
detector parameters and design approval states are unchanged.
